title: Trump is right: EV range anxiety is a disease – THIS is how we cure it!
content: On today’s time-sensitive episode of Quick Charge, we revisit the idea that even a broken clock is right twice a day as we examine US President Donald Trump’s takes on electric vehicles, range anxiety, highway road signs, and why he’s absolutely right.

title: Global EV sales rose in July – except in North America
content: Global EV sales rose 9% in July, but the growth map couldn’t look more uneven.

title: Tesla plans massive new V4 Supercharger in San Francisco
content:
Tesla wants to build one of its biggest Superchargers yet right in the middle of San Francisco. Planning permits have been filed for a 124-stall V4 station on the city’s south side.
The site is a yellow-cab storage lot at the corner of Alemany and Bayshore, wedged against the US-101 freeway. The permits also call for a 400-square-foot amenity building on the property.

title: US EV prices are going back up as discounts shrink
content: After six straight months of year-over-year declines, the average transaction price (ATP) paid for a new EV in the US is rising again.

title: As EV sales, oil costs and temperatures spike, UK gov’t considers… fewer EVs?
content: The UK government is considering relaxing its landmark electric vehicle rules, even in the face of inflated oil prices, a recordbreaking year for temperatures and wildfires, and EV sales that are already rising fast enough to meet the government’s current target.

title: BYD’s new electric sedan is the size of a Tesla Model 3, but half the price
content: BYD’s new sedan is about the size of a Tesla Model 3, but it’s half the cost in China. The new Seal 06 went on sale in China, starting at just 109,900 yuan, or about $16,500.

title: Lectric XP Lite2 e-bike + largest $508 bundle from $999, Anker SOLIX 3,840Wh F3800 power station $1,800, EcoFlow, tools, more
content: Leading our midweek Green Deals pack is a spotlight on the largest bundle in 2026 on Lectric’s XP Lite2 Long-Range Folding Lightweight e-bikes with $508 in FREE gear from $999 that is one of several solid deals from the brand’s Back to School Sale. Next, Amazon is undercutting Anker’s SOLIX Fan Fest Mega Sale on the 3,840Wh F3800 Portable Power Station for $1,800, while EcoFlow has launched a 48-hour four-unit bundle flash sale starting from $979. We also have a one-day-only 2026 low for a 48V G

title: Volkswagen launches the ID.3 Neo in the UK with up to 390 miles of range
content: Volkswagen announced that prices for the ID.3 Neo will start at £33,080 ($45,000). The electric hatch is bringing an all-new look inside and out, a longer driving range, and Volkswagen’s latest tech and software.

title: EVgo + GM open 350 kW flagship charging for EVs with trailers
content: EVgo and GM have opened a new flagship DC fast-charging station near Detroit with 12 high-power stalls, CCS and NACS connectors, and pull-through charging for EVs towing trailers.

title: The strange story behind Colorado’s ‘no catch’ free e-bike company
content:
It started as one of the most talked-about e-bike deals in the country. Colorado residents could get what was advertised as a “free” electric bike by applying the state’s e-bike tax credit, with Bear Trail Bikes matching the discount. Customers were generally left paying little more than sales tax.
For many riders, it sounded too good to pass up.

title: Jaguar’s new EV interior is just as controversial as its exterior [Images]
content: Jaguar revealed the interior of the new Type 01 EV for the first time, and it sure is “like no other.”

title: This $1,800 electric motorcycle hits 70 MPH and could change the game
content: A new player in the industry, Avore, thinks its EX2S electric motorcycle could shake things up with impressive performance and accessible pricing.

title: Ford has a new $25,000 crossover SUV coming, but will it go electric?
content: The crossover SUV will be Ford’s lowest-priced vehicle, starting at around $25,000. According to dealers who were shown a preview of the vehicle, it will not be based on the Universal EV platform.

title: Waymo has nearly 1,000 robotaxis waiting at its Arizona factory
content:
Waymo has 684 of its new Ojai robotaxis finished and ready to deploy at its factory in Mesa, Arizona, according to the latest aerial count of the site.
That’s out of 953 Ojai vehicles on the lot in total, or 72% already converted. It’s the clearest sign yet of how much driverless capacity Waymo is stockpiling.

title: Gas prices are about to go even higher. Here’s how to use an e-bike to save money
content:
If you are like most people and currently drive a gasoline-powered car, the pain is about to become even worse. US government officials have warned that gas prices are expected to rise further as tensions around the Strait of Hormuz continue to disrupt the global oil supply.
While we can’t control geopolitical events, we can control how much gasoline we actually need to buy. And that’s where e-bikes come in.

title: Kia EV3 prices and range revealed, starting at $30,000
content: Kia’s electric SUV is more affordable than expected, starting at just $29,890. The 2027 Kia EV3 offers up to 321 miles of range, fast charging, and plenty of extras.

title: Hyundai launches the range-topping IONIQ 9 Calligraphy Black Ink in the UK and Europe
content: The new Hyundai IONIQ 9 Black Ink edition sits above the Calligraphy as the new range-topping trim.

title: Anker SOLIX Mega Sale offers up to 48% power station discounts + one-day-only C1000X $399 off, AeroGarden, more
content: We’ve got a power station-heavy Green Deals for you today, starting with the freshly launched Anker SOLIX Fan Fest Mega Sale with up to 48% initial discounts, an exclusive bonus savings code, a FREE power station gift – all starting from $190. We also spotted a one-day-only deal on Anker’s SOLIX C1000X 1,024Wh Portable Power Station down at $480, as well as a similar one-day deal on the Bluetti AC50B 488Wh Portable Power Station for $259. From there, we also have AeroGarden’s Harvest XL Indoor H

title: China sales numbers are in: EVs up while everything with an engine collapses
content: The structural collapse of gas car sales has continued in the world’s largest auto market, with July numbers showing that the only type of vehicle doing well is pure battery-electric cars, while sales of every other type of vehicle continue to drop precipitously for months on end.

title: Cadillac will hand-build a custom Escalade IQ for you, but it will cost an extra $55,000
content: Cadillac is giving buyers the opportunity to customize the flagship electric SUV through its bespoke program, which will be hand-built in Michigan. The catch? It’s not going to be cheap.

title: Tesla recalls 20,000 Model 3/Y for headlights that are too bright
content: If you’ve ever been driving at night and felt like the car behind you had too-bright headlights,  that car might have been a Tesla, and it might have felt that way because its lights broke the rules.

title: Tesla files for $10.1B ‘Project Crystal Sun’ solar factory in Texas
content:
Tesla has filed for a $10.1 billion solar cell factory in Fort Bend County, Texas, under the codename “Project Crystal Sun,” according to a tax-incentive application posted by the Texas Comptroller.
The filing pegs the plant at 9,712 permanent jobs, roughly 3,050 acres near Richmond, and commercial production starting in the first quarter of 2029. It’s the largest US manufacturing investment Tesla has ever put on paper.

title: Ukraine debuts mine-resistant all-wheel drive combat electric motorcycle
content: Electric motorcycles have already proven themselves in military roles thanks to their quiet operation, but Ukraine has just taken the concept several steps further. The country’s newly approved MUL.E electric motorcycle is more than just another battery-powered dirt bike – it’s an all-wheel-drive machine specifically designed for battlefield logistics, stealth operations, and even traversing certain minefields.

title: Oil giant rips out gas pumps for BYD’s 1,500 kW EV chargers
content:
Sinopec, China’s biggest fuel retailer, just gutted one of its Shanghai gas stations and swapped the pumps for BYD’s 1,500 kW flash chargers.
And this wasn’t a case of bolting a couple of chargers onto the edge of the forecourt. Sinopec pulled the underground gasoline tanks out of the ground and turned the whole site into an EV-only charging hub.

title: The 2027 Audi Q6 e-tron delivers more driving range than expected
content: Audi’s midsize electric SUV drove further than advertised. The 2027 Audi Q6 e-tron has an EPA-estimated driving range of up to 301 miles, but in the real world, it traveled even further.

title: GM exits $3.5B Indiana battery plant as Samsung SDI takes full control
content:
Samsung SDI is taking full control of its Indiana battery plant. The South Korean cell maker is buying out General Motors’ 49.99% stake in their joint venture, according to a regulatory filing, ending GM’s ownership in the $3.5 billion factory.
That turns the New Carlisle, Indiana plant into Samsung SDI’s first wholly owned battery factory in North America.

title: GM makes charging easy while Elon bets big on fossil fuels and Leno talks Tesla
content: On today’s super simple episode of Quick Charge, we talk about GM’s new Energy Pass, SpaceX’s big bet on fossil fuels, and Tesla’s long-promised Roadster set to arrive “real soon.” Again. For what is nearly the tenth year in a row.

title: Lexus undercuts luxury rivals with 2027 ES prices starting under $50,000
content: The all-electric 2027 Lexus ES returns for the 2027 model year, with prices starting under $50,000.

title: Here’s our first look at the Range Rover GT in real life [Video]
content: Range Rover is adding a fifth member to its lineup, but this one is a bit of an outlier. The new GT brings a sharp, fastback design that looks even sportier on the road.

title: Tesla design chief says new Roadster coming ‘very soon’ — sure
content:
Tesla’s chief designer says the new Roadster is coming “very soon.” We are talking about the same car Tesla revealed in 2017 and promised to build by 2020.
Franz von Holzhausen said it on the latest episode of Jay Leno’s Garage. When Leno pressed him on it, he doubled down: “very soon.” Leno’s deadpan reply, “10 years… just shy of 10 years,” said the rest.

title: Tesla exhausts its California MyFirstEV rebate allocation in 5 days
content:
Tesla ran through its entire share of California’s new MyFirstEV rebate program in just five days.. The rebate only went live for Tesla buyers on August 3.
Buyers claimed roughly half of Tesla’s allocation in the first three days and drained the rest by August 8, spending an estimated $18 million in state and matching rebates on Tesla vehicles alone.

title: Kia EV3 inches closer to its US launch
content: The EV3 is finally almost here. With its US launch just around the corner, here’s what to expect from Kia’s entry-level electric SUV.

title: Tesla unveils first Cybercab with Starlink antenna integrated
content:
Tesla’s robotaxi account posted photos today of what it’s calling the first Cybercab with a Starlink antenna built into the vehicle.
The pictures show a gold Cybercab parked at Gigafactory Texas, with a low-profile satellite antenna integrated into the roof. It’s the physical version of an integration Tesla teased with a diagram last month.

Right behind it we have Heybike’s Back to School Sale lineup, which includes the Villain Electric Dirt Bike down at a new $1,259 low. Next, Bluetti has launched an Emergency Backup Sale with up to 38% discounts on power stations, our exclusive bonus savings code, three tiers of bonus savings thresholds, and FREE gi

title: Mercedes teases its upcoming 1,000+hp AMG electric SUV
content: Mercedes teased a new sport SUV on its AMG social media channels over the weekend, expected to be the SUV counterpart to its bonkers 1,153hp AMG GT 4-door revealed in May.

title: 49ers’ Shanahan crashed his Tesla on Autopilot reaching for his phone
content:
San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan crashed his Tesla Model S on July 14 while the car was running on Autopilot. He was reaching for a phone that had dropped out of reach, and he took his eyes off the road.
The crash left him with a concussion, a broken nose, three broken ribs, a broken left hand, and 40 stitches over his right eye. And to his credit, he isn’t blaming the car.

title: Ford reveals Fathom EV pickup prices in the US and Canada
content: Ford’s new electric pickup will go on sale in the US early next year, starting at $28,350. Buyers in Canada won’t have to wait much longer, with pre-orders also set to open in early 2027.

title: Getting your teen a back-to-school e-bike? Don’t forget this cool-looking protective gear
content:
Back-to-school season often means shopping for backpacks, notebooks, and maybe even a new ride. For a growing number of families, that ride is an electric bike.
And I’m all for it. Giving teenagers the freedom to get themselves to school, sports practice, or a friend’s house without needing a car is one of the best things e-bikes can offer. But just like we’d encourage a new driver to wear a seatbelt, young e-bike riders should be equipped with the right protective gear too.

title: Volvo’s new sedan breaks cover, but it may not be the EV we expected [Images]
content: Volvo is expected to reenter the segment with an all-new sedan, but it may not be as electric as expected.

title: Archer makes wild deal with Boeing swapping eVTOL startups for equity
content:
Archer Aviation is buying three of Boeing’s aerospace subsidiaries: autonomous air-taxi developer Wisk Aero, military drone maker Insitu, and airspace-software firm SkyGrid. The deal also hands Boeing a stake in Archer.
Investors loved it. Archer (ACHR) stock jumped more than 20% on Monday, and the acquisition instantly turns a pre-revenue eVTOL startup into a company with a profitable defense business behind it.
It could accelerate Archer’s eVTOL plans.

title: Musk’s Terafab chip plant will run on gas, not Tesla solar
content:
SpaceX confirmed it will power Terafab, its $16.8 billion chip megafactory in Texas, with its own natural gas power plants and “very large battery arrays.” Tesla solar isn’t in the plan.
That’s despite Tesla being a partner on the project, and despite Tesla selling solar panels, Powerwalls, and grid-scale batteries built for exactly this kind of load.

title: BYD’s kei EV already looks like a hit with over 1,000 orders in its first 2 weeks
content: BYD’s first electric kei car received over 1,000 orders in just two weeks after it went on sale.

title: Why does Monarc build its e-bikes with their forks on backward?
content: If you’ve spotted one of Monarc’s new e-bikes, there’s a good chance one of your first thoughts was, “Wait… did they install the fork backwards?”

title: Survey Sunday: this is how Chinese EVs will make it to America
content: For the last few weeks, we’ve been running a sidebar survey how (or if) Electrek readers think the first Chinese electric cars will make it onto US roads. After receiving more than 3,000 responses, here’s what you told us.

title: Pony.ai to put 100,000 autonomous electric trucks on the road by 2030 [video]
content: Chinese autonomy experts Pony.ai are planning to put 1,000 autonomous electric commercial trucks to work by 2027, but it’s the company’s plans to put 100,000 self-driving trucks on the road by 2030 that’s making headlines.

title: Paris now requires electric scooter riders to wear high-vis vests or face fines
content: Paris is getting tougher on electric scooter safety, with new rules now requiring riders to wear both a helmet and a high-visibility vest while using their scooters on public roads.

title: Zero will pay new riders to get on electric motorcycles… just not in the US
content: Zero Motorcycles has launched a new incentive program that offers cash back to newly licensed riders who purchase one of the company’s electric motorcycles or scooters. It’s an interesting way to encourage new motorcyclists to skip internal combustion and go electric from day one.

title: Sneaky safari: Thula Solutions’ electric 4×4 gets you closer to nature [video]
content: Thula Solutions’ new electric safari vehicles aren’t repurposed diesels – they were engineered from the ground up as purpose-built electric safari vehicles designed to get curious tourists, scientists, and park workers closer to the action than ever before.

title: Heavy equipment space race heats up with new Vermeer lunar excavator [update]
content:
International equipment manufacturer Vermeer has unveiled a full-scale prototype of its Interlune excavator, a machine designed to ingest 100 metric tons of rocks and dirt per hour, extracting valuable helium as it makes its way across the surface … of the Moon.
UPDATE 08AUG26: Interlune and Vermeer have expand their partnership.

title: GM is making EV charging a LOT easier
content: In mid-June GM hosted their 2026 Empower event, where they made several major announcements. But there are two in particular that will be big benefits to the day-to-day electric vehicle driver, especially when it comes to charging GM brand EVs.

title: Volkswagen’s new electric era begins with reveal of ID. ERA 5X SUV
content: Revealed in a new filing from China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), the new VW ID. ERA 5X electric SUV is the first pure BEV on the brand’s new Compact Main Platform (CMP) platform.

title: NYC declares war on fast e-bikes, sends cease-and-desist letters to Amazon and Walmart
content: Micromobility regulation continues to tighten in New York City, and now Mayor Zohran Mamdani is taking aim at the online retailers that have become a major source of high-speed electric bikes and scooters.

content: Jaguar's all-electric Type 01 comes with a very beige interior that divides the four seats with a "spine" that spans the length of the cabin. New photos shared by Jaguar show a low-slung driver's seat, alongside a slim dashboard with a smartphone-style display in the center. content: Joby Aviation announced it was acquiring Dayton, Ohio-based defense firm Resonant Sciences in a $500 million deal, in a bid by the electric aircraft company to expand further into the military industrial complex. content: Boeing is selling three of its electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) subsidiaries to Archer Aviation, in addition to taking an undisclosed stake in the San Jose-based company. content: Ford is rolling out a new AI-powered assistant that can answer questions about your Ford or Lincoln vehicle, such as how much fuel you'll need for your next road trip or whether your truck can tow that new motor boat. content: Four weeks ago, San Francisco 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan was involved in an accident near downtown Palo Alto. At the time, Shanahan said only that the accident was his fault. content: According to an Economic Daily News report spotted by MacRumors, executives for Apple supplier Pegatron confirmed during an earnings call that the iPhone 18 Pro series phones will launch this fall, but the base iPhone 18 won't arrive until the first quarter of next year. content: Amazon is fully stepping back from MMOs. After saying last year that it would be halting "a significant amount" of its work on first-party AAA games, "specifically around MMOs," Amazon will be handing over live operations of Throne and Liberty and Lost Ark in the West to other companies, according to announcements on Wednesday. content:
